definitions.meaning: sacrificed; 3rd pl. p. of blótan to sacrifice

quotations.old_english: Hú ða burhleóde on Cartaina bliótan [ = bleóton] men hira godum
quotations.english: how the towns-people in Carthage sacrificed men to their gods

source_text: bliótan for bleóton sacrificed; 3rd pl. p. of blótan to sacrifice :-- Hú ða burhleóde on Cartaina bliótan [ = bleóton] men hira godum how the towns-people in Carthage sacrificed men to their gods, Ors. cont. 4, 4; Bos. 11, 32.
